task_description: Build the HIJISTREAM mobile/TV application (Android TV/Google TV) using Expo React Native as specified in TDD.md. The app mirrors the existing web app functionality with TV-optimized navigation (D-pad, focus indicators) and uses AsyncStorage for caching.

verification.summary: Expo export (bun run export) bundles successfully into dist/. Lint (bun run lint) passes with zero errors. Two review passes completed - all critical issues fixed (WebView iframe bridge, VirtualizedList nesting, dynamic columns, removed unused deps, removed deprecated TV props). No test framework in scope for mobile app.
